what: R13 second pass, BEFORE the fixes: revision 9266a1e with only the new checks copied in (scripts/security.ts and five server test files). HTTP checks R15, R22 to R25 from a run with QED_SECURITY_ONLY=r13-leads; in-process checks R16 to R21 and R26 from a run with QED_SECURITY_ONLY=r13-inprocess (after R26 was rewritten for the final fix of L-11). R14 is in ...-chain.json.

checks.name: a member below admin reads another member's question to Ask only as hashes: no model-written title or refusal reason in any section of the case
checks.asvs: V8.2.2 data-specific access; V14.2.6 sensitive data
checks.expected: the case 200 without the title or the reason; the asker reads both
checks.observed: operator 200, 2 of 2 found: Pay Hidden Vendor 4,90,000 before the audit | Hidden Vendor is not a payee of this workspace; asker 200 reads the title

checks.name: a model's proposal is its asker's: another member below admin can neither dismiss it nor start an instruction from it
checks.expected: dismiss 404; instruction from it 404; the proposal still new

checks.name: an instruction's actions, a tenant's bills and a tenant's instructions are found through an index; an instruction cannot carry an arbitrary proposal id
checks.asvs: V15.2.2 resource limits; V2.2.1 input validation
checks.expected: three SEARCH ... USING INDEX plans; the 60,000-character id 404 and nothing stored
checks.observed: SCAN actions | SCAN bills | SCAN programs; long id 200, 1 stored

checks.name: in a business, only an owner or admin other than the member who made the change clears a notice of a change to who can act
checks.asvs: V8.2.1 function-level access; V16.3.2 security events
checks.expected: operator 403; the starter 403; still open; the owner 200 and it is cleared
checks.observed: operator 200; starter 200; open after both 0; owner 200; cleared 1

checks.name: a password session can neither ask again for a protective run's approval (withdrawing the request waiting) nor withdraw it; the owner's passkey then confirms it
checks.asvs: V8.2.1 function-level access; V6.3.4 consistent strength across pathways
checks.expected: ask again 401 stepup_required; withdraw 401 stepup_required; the owner's confirmation 200

checks.name: one person cannot spend the vault service's host-wide budgets through many workspaces: four vault set-ups a day, and 480 requests an hour over all their workspaces
checks.observed: failed: Error: promise resolved "{ …(12) }" instead of rejecting

checks.name: after the deadline, a release request the provider keeps waiting does not hold off the client's refund
checks.asvs: V2.3.2 workflow integrity; V2.3.4 business-logic limits (API6)
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected { refused: 'already_pending' } to match object { ok: { jobId: Any<String> } }

checks.name: in a business, a vault request needs the workspace's own number of signatures when it is larger than the chain's threshold; a request that only stops something needs no more than the chain asks
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected 1 to be 2 // Object.is equality

checks.name: the provider does not read what the client's vault service said about the client's refused funding (it names the client vault's free balance)
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected 'Refused before sending: the job costs…' not to match /12\.34|free funds/

checks.name: questions from many workspaces are bounded together: at most QED_ASK_CONCURRENT model calls at once (the next is refused, not queued), and at most QED_ASK_ALL_HOURLY in an hour
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected [ 'answered', 'answered', 'answered' ] to deeply equal [ 'answered', 'answered', 'busy' ]

checks.name: each workspace's tick, or its pause, is recorded as that workspace's own event, naming only its own vault
checks.asvs: V8.2.2 data-specific access; V16.2.5 sensitive data in logs
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ StringContaining{…} ]

checks.name: with a recovery started by email under way, a backup one may start too, and the email one is still shown and finished with its own link and key
checks.observed: failed: AssertionError: expected { state: 'codes', …(6) } to match object { state: 'ready', …(1) }
